
## resolution = `r resolution` {-}

```{r}
cluster_col <- paste0("PROT_snn_res.", resolution)
seu$seurat_clusters <- seu[[cluster_col]]
Idents(seu) <- "seurat_clusters"
pal <- cluster_palette(levels(Idents(seu)))
```

```{r, fig.dim=c(10,10)}
DimPlot(seu, reduction = umap_red, label = TRUE, cols = pal)
ImageDimPlot(seu, fov = "myfov", size = 1, cols = pal) + scale_y_reverse()
```

**Cluster sizes**

```{r}
cluster_sizes <- data.frame(cluster = seu[[cluster_col]] %>% dplyr::pull()) %>%
  count(cluster, name = "cell.count") %>%
  mutate(pct = 100 * cell.count / sum(cell.count), label = paste0(round(pct, 2), "%"))

ggplot(cluster_sizes, aes(x = cell.count, y = reorder(cluster, cell.count))) +
  geom_col(fill = "steelblue") +
  geom_text(aes(label = label), hjust = -0.2, size = 3.5) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))) +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(x = "Cell count", y = "Cluster")
```

```{r}
avg <- AverageExpression(seu, assays = "PROT", group.by = "seurat_clusters", slot = "data")$PROT
cluster_labels <- colnames(avg) %>% gsub(pattern = "^g", replacement = "")

# Mean marker intensity per cluster, also written out for downstream use
write.csv(
  as.data.frame(avg) %>% rownames_to_column("Marker"),
  file = paste0(samplename, "_res.", resolution, "_cluster_mean_intensity.csv"),
  row.names = FALSE, quote = FALSE
)
```

**Average intensity (scaled row-wise)**

```{r}
pheatmap(avg, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE, labels_col = cluster_labels, scale = "row")
```

```{r}
# Violin grid: aim for ~21 cluster-violins per row of plots, 10/21 in per violin and 10/3 in per row
n_clusters <- ncol(avg)
n_plot_markers <- nrow(avg)
plots_per_row <- ceiling(max(n_clusters, 21) / n_clusters)
eff.fig.width <- (plots_per_row * n_plot_markers) * (10 / 21)
eff.fig.height <- ceiling(n_plot_markers / plots_per_row) * (10 / 3)
```

```{r, fig.width=eff.fig.width, fig.height=eff.fig.height}
VlnPlot(
  seu,
  features = marker_cols,
  group.by = "seurat_clusters",
  pt.size = 0,
  ncol = plots_per_row,
  same.y.lims = TRUE,
  cols = pal
)
```

**Average of scaled intensity (colour scaled column-wise)**

Scaled intensity centres and scales each marker's intensity. The heatmap colour is then scaled per cluster, which helps pinpoint the markers that stand out in each cluster.

```{r}
avg_scaled <- AverageExpression(seu, assays = "PROT", group.by = "seurat_clusters", slot = "scale.data")$PROT
pheatmap(avg_scaled, cluster_rows = FALSE, cluster_cols = FALSE,
         labels_col = colnames(avg_scaled) %>% gsub(pattern = "^g", replacement = ""), scale = "column")
```

```{r, results='asis', eval=has_roi, fig.dim=c(10,6)}
cat("**Cluster composition by region**\n\n")
roi_composition <- seu[[]] %>%
  select(roi_class, cluster = all_of(cluster_col)) %>%
  count(roi_class, cluster) %>%
  group_by(roi_class) %>%
  mutate(fraction = n / sum(n))

print(
  ggplot(roi_composition, aes(x = roi_class, y = fraction, fill = cluster)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = NULL, y = "fraction of cells", fill = "Cluster")
)
```
